title: Bias after Prompting: Persistent Discrimination in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating co-reference resolution of male and female pronouns to gender-stereotyped occupations using the WinoBias and Winogender datasets. Bias is measured through intrinsic next-token prediction and extrinsic prompt-adapted multiple-choice question answering to calculate Occupation Selection Bias (O-SB) and Aggregate Selection Bias (A-SB).

Multiple-choice question answering using the BBQ-lite dataset to calculate a BBQ Bias Score (BBS), which measures the relative likelihood of selecting an age-stereotyped label in response to negative versus non-negative questions.
